title: cost-lighthouse: tenant-aware default prescriber + lightweight profiling CLI
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Many tenants arrive with no prefill/batching/caching defaults. Operators either apply conservative defaults or manually tune per-tenant which is slow and error-prone. This PR introduces 'cost-lighthouse', a lightweight prescriber and CLI profiler that generates tenant-aware defaults for batching, KV-prefill, and quantization profiles using a short, single-pass sample of real traffic. The feature targets faster safe on-ramps for new tenants and a deterministic dry-run mode for SREs and solutions engineers. What this PR does: 1) runtime/econ: add a prescriber engine that consumes a small workload sample and emits a ranked set of default profiles (batch_shape, prefill_hint, quant_profile) plus confidence signals and suggested safety gates; 2) cli: add lighthouse_cli (dry-run mode, simulated SLO/econ delta report, export to policy-as-code YAML); 3) telemetry: emit lighthouse.profiles.generated and lighthouse.econ.delta metrics and lightweight traces; 4) docs/examples: walk-through for tenant on-boarding and a troubleshooting playbook; 5) tests: unit + integration harness with synthetic tenant samples. Design notes: - Tenant-aware scoring: profiles are scored by a composite utility function (latency SLO hit, unit cost delta, model-quality proxy using ngram-match on a small eval set) with tunable weights. - Lamp-post sampling: the CLI takes a short stream (default 500 requests) and folds traffic by signature to preserve diversity while keeping cost low. - Safety gates: profiles include a conservative fallback when confidence < 0.6; operators can pin or autodeploy with a canary fraction. - Policy-as-code export: generated defaults are YAML compatible with the existing prefills/policies DSL. Rollout plan: - Stage 1 (canary): CLI only, SREs run dry-run and review reports. - Stage 2: automated suggestions in Console (opt-in). - Stage 3: auto-apply with tenant-level guardrails. Checklist: - [x] core prescriber implementation - [x] CLI with dry-run + export - [x] metrics/tracing - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] docs + example tenant run - [x] e2e smoke on canary cluster Migration notes: Existing tenant defaults are not modified by default; operator must opt-in. Generated YAML can be applied with the prefills importer. Testing: Ran unit tests and an integration run against a tenant simulator (see CI). See CI checks and conversation below.

release_notes: Introduce 'cost-lighthouse' prescriber and CLI: generates tenant-aware batching/prefill/quantization defaults from a short workload sample. CLI supports dry-run and export to policy-as-code. Opt-in rollout. Metrics emitted under lighthouse.*.
notes_for_ops: Default behavior is opt-in. To evaluate a tenant: run 'redwood lighthouse --sample /path/to/trace --dry-run --export candidate.yaml'. If you opt to apply, import via prefills importer. Canary manifest included for staged rollout.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: aggressive defaults could violate latency SLOs for latency-sensitive workloads. Mitigation: conservative fallback when confidence < 0.6, canary fraction rollout, metric-based alerting (lighthouse.econ.delta and per-tenant latency regressions).
